stages.scope: 31 new records, source validation and persisted extraction results

exclusions: Actual billing and provider prompt-cache discounts were not captured.
Development experiments and focused model comparisons are excluded.

limitations: Initial processing is the sum of separately timed extraction and cached publication stages, not a single end-to-end invocation.
Query benchmarks cover one patient and 31 source documents; they do not measure capacity at 500K or one million documents.
Snapshot loading currently decodes published patient JSON and cached source records; query-only latency excludes it.

benchmark_context: benchmark.json now contains refreshed saved-plan calculation timings for the current submitted abstraction.
